berlin-motorcycle-escapes-harz-edge-long.story: A proper escape from Berlin motorcycle escapes with roads worth waking up for. A 633 km loop that starts and ends near Baruth, about 11 h 31 of riding. On the way it passes Scenic stretch near Premnitz, near Wittstock and near Myślibórz. near Niedergörsdorf is the high point. It crosses from Germany into Poland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3358 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 10 km this is Million Dollar Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

million-dollar-highway.story: Out of Silverton, one way: 70 km, roughly 1 h 12 in the saddle. The stops in between: Red Mountain Pass and Bear Creek Falls. The highest point is about 3,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Bieszczady Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 31 km this is Bieszczady Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-turzansk-tserkva-of-saint-michael.story: From Rzepedź it runs 115 km to Rzepedź; allow about 1 h 59 of riding. It goes by way of Udava, Havešová Primeval Forest and back through Udava. It crosses from Poland into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Much of it runs through woodland.
